items.title: Solana Shanghai Event Halted After Police Visit, Raising China Fears
items.summary: The Solana Shanghai event was postponed after attendees reported blocked venue access, but the foundation gave no replacement date yet.

items.title: Bitcoin Optech Newsletter #427
items.summary: This week’s newsletter summarizes the disclosure of two denial-of-service vulnerabilities in older versions of Eclair and describes a proposed scheme for running complex multi-round contracts inside Lightning channels. Also included are our regular sections announcing new releases and release candidates and describing notable changes to popular Bitcoin infrastructure software.

items.title: BingX EU Secures MiCAR License, Advancing Regulated Crypto Services Across Europe
items.summary: VIENNA, October 15, 2026 – BingX EU (MEGE zweite GmbH) has secured its Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA or MiCAR) license from Austria’s Financial Market Authority (FMA), that will enable the platform to offer regulated crypto services across 29 countries of the European Economic Area (EEA), subject to ongoing passporting arrangements. The authorization marks a significant milestone in BingX’s European expansion, providing EEA users with access to digital asset services under a unified regulatory framework built on transparency, security, and investor protection. items.title: PPI for final demand increases 1.3% in September; goods advance 2.6%, services rise 0.8%
items.summary: The Producer Price Index for final demand increased 1.3 percent in September. Prices for final demand goods rose 2.6 percent, and the index for final demand services advanced 0.8 percent. Prices for final demand moved up 6.3 percent for the 12 months ended in September.

items.title: Google Quantum 40x Breakthrough Rekindles Fears of Q-Day
items.summary: Bitcoin quantum risk grows as Google reports 40-fold lower errors and 99.9% accuracy, but no machine is close to breaking Bitcoin’s signatures.

items.title: CPI for all items increases 0.6% in September; gasoline rises
items.summary: In September, the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers rose 0.6 percent, seasonally adjusted (SA), and rose 3.7 percent over the year, not seasonally adjusted (NSA). The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3 percent in September (SA), up 2.6 percent over the year (NSA).

items.title: XRP Price Drops, But ETF Defies Crypto Bloodbath as Bitcoin and Ethereum Funds Bleed
items.summary: XRP ETF inflows reached about $740,000 on October 14, extending a 13-week streak as hotter US inflation sent XRP down 5.11%.

items.title: Crypto Regulation: Firms Face AI Controls Before Dedicated Rules Arrive
items.summary: Crypto compliance is shifting as supervisors demand human oversight, testing, data quality and risk controls for AI tools, and no crypto AI rule.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF Records $260 Million Outflows, Led by Fidelity and BlackRock
